standards.description: Understand the concept of a ratio and use ratio language to describe a ratio relationship between two quantities.
standards.cluster: Understand ratio concepts and use ratio reasoning to solve problems.

standards.description: Understand the concept of a unit rate a/b associated with a ratio a:b with b != 0, and use rate language in the context of a ratio relationship.
standards.cluster: Understand ratio concepts and use ratio reasoning to solve problems.

standards.description: Use ratio and rate reasoning to solve real-world and mathematical problems, e.g., by reasoning about tables of equivalent ratios, tape diagrams, double number line diagrams, or equations.
standards.cluster: Understand ratio concepts and use ratio reasoning to solve problems.

standards.description: Interpret and compute quotients of fractions, and solve word problems involving division of fractions by fractions.
standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division to divide fractions by fractions.

standards.description: Fluently divide multi-digit numbers using the standard algorithm.
standards.cluster: Compute fluently with multi-digit numbers and find common factors and multiples.

standards.description: Fluently add, subtract, multiply, and divide multi-digit decimals using the standard algorithm for each operation.
standards.cluster: Compute fluently with multi-digit numbers and find common factors and multiples.

standards.description: Understand that positive and negative numbers are used together to describe quantities having opposite directions or values.
standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of numbers to the system of rational numbers.

standards.description: Understand a rational number as a point on the number line. Extend number line diagrams and coordinate axes familiar from previous grades to represent points on the line and in the plane with negative number coordinates.
standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of numbers to the system of rational numbers.

standards.description: Understand ordering and absolute value of rational numbers.
standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of numbers to the system of rational numbers.

standards.description: Solve real-world and mathematical problems by graphing points in all four quadrants of the coordinate plane.
standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of numbers to the system of rational numbers.

standards.description: Write and evaluate numerical expressions involving whole-number exponents.
standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of arithmetic to algebraic expressions.

standards.description: Write, read, and evaluate expressions in which letters stand for numbers.
standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of arithmetic to algebraic expressions.

standards.description: Apply the properties of operations to generate equivalent expressions.
standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of arithmetic to algebraic expressions.

standards.description: Identify when two expressions are equivalent (i.e., when the two expressions name the same number regardless of which value is substituted into them).
standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of arithmetic to algebraic expressions.

standards.description: Understand solving an equation or inequality as a process of answering a question: which values from a specified set, if any, make the equation or inequality true?
standards.cluster: Reason about and solve one-variable equations and inequalities.

standards.description: Use variables to represent equal numbers and write expressions when solving a real-world or mathematical problem.
standards.cluster: Reason about and solve one-variable equations and inequalities.

standards.description: Solve real-world and mathematical problems by writing and solving equations of the form x + p = q and px = q.
standards.cluster: Reason about and solve one-variable equations and inequalities.

standards.description: Use variables to represent two quantities in a real-world problem that change in relationship to one another.
standards.cluster: Represent and analyze quantitative relationships between dependent and independent variables.

standards.description: Find the area of right triangles, other triangles, special quadrilaterals, and polygons by composing into rectangles or decomposing into triangles and other shapes.
standards.cluster: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving area, surface area, and volume.

standards.description: Find the volume of a right rectangular prism with fractional edge lengths by packing it with unit cubes.
standards.cluster: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving area, surface area, and volume.

standards.description: Draw polygons in the coordinate plane given coordinates for the vertices.
standards.cluster: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving area, surface area, and volume.

standards.description: Represent three-dimensional figures using nets made up of rectangles and triangles, and use the nets to find the surface area of these figures.
standards.cluster: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving area, surface area, and volume.

standards.description: Recognize a statistical question as one that anticipates variability in the data related to the question and accounts for it in the answers.
standards.cluster: Develop understanding of statistical variability.

standards.description: Understand that a set of data collected to answer a statistical question has a distribution which can be described by its center, spread, and overall shape.
standards.cluster: Develop understanding of statistical variability.

standards.description: Recognize that a measure of center for a numerical data set summarizes all of its values with a single number, while a measure of variation describes how its values vary with a single number.
standards.cluster: Develop understanding of statistical variability.

standards.description: Display numerical data in plots on a number line, including dot plots, histograms, and box plots.
standards.cluster: Summarize and describe distributions.

standards.description: Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context.
standards.cluster: Summarize and describe distributions.
